translations.web: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
translations.bsb: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
translations.kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell
translations.asv: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.
